prompt:
Edit of the attached image (a hand-painted top-down game map of a small cosy flat). Keep EVERYTHING exactly as it is: same canvas size and framing, same camera, every object at exactly the same position and size, same floor, rug, walls, colours, lighting and painting style (clean dark ink outlines, soft painterly cel shading). Change ONLY the one area described below and leave every other pixel untouched. STRICT: no people, no animals, no readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark.

CHANGE: In the narrow strip of back wall between the large cork pinboard (top center) and the round porthole window, add a slim steel ladder standing upright against the wall, leading up to a small open roof hatch in the ceiling beam at the very top edge; green leaves, a tomato vine and a few flowers hang down through the hatch from a rooftop garden. At the foot of the ladder on the floor: two small seedling trays and a little green watering can. Keep the ladder thin so the pinboard and the porthole stay fully visible.
